utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — I can help with the repair drive. What do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Leo. If you could bring some basic tools and maybe a tarp, that would really help.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure — I’ll bring some basic tools and a tarp.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to help, but I want to make sure we’ve got the timing and drop-off sorted out first. What exactly do you need from me for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just confirmation on the timing and where to drop things off. Can you send me the details once they’re set?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Absolutely — I’ll confirm the timing and the drop-off point first, then send you the details once it’s all set.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, the repair drive? Right, I heard something about that—what do we need to fix?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Mostly little things, I think—loose cabinets, a leaky faucet, maybe a squeaky door or two. I keep meaning to check the list again.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, that sounds familiar. If you’ve got the list, I can take a look too.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’ll bring that up at the repair drive and let everyone know the plan.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll spread the word too if I hear anything new.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, thanks — I’ll make sure everyone gets the update at the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Gus, I’m a bit late—what still needs fixing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Dane, no worries—mostly a couple loose railings, one squeaky gate, and a leaky faucet if you’re up for it.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I can take the squeaky gate and help with the railings—show me where to start.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Morning, Quinn. What’s the plan for the repair drive today?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Morning, Eli! I’m spreading the word and lining up folks to bring tools and spare parts.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good, I like a clear plan. Let me know when and where to bring my tools.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sam, are we still on for the repair drive today, and what time should I be there?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes, we’re still on for today. Come by around 2 PM and we’ll get started.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, I’ll be there at 2 PM. Do you need me to bring any tools or supplies?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m glad we’re doing the repair drive—there are a few folks I can check in with and help coordinate. Want me to spread the word or match people up with tasks?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, please spread the word and match people to tasks. If you can, keep track of who’s at which house so I can follow up.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word, match people to tasks, and keep a simple list of who’s at which house for you.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’m in. Tell me where you need help for the repair drive, and I’ll do my part.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Mara—that means a lot. Could you help me sort donations at the community center this Saturday and hand out flyers on the block?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely, Rosa — I can sort donations at the community center this Saturday and hand out flyers on the block too.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can keep an eye on what supplies we already have and what we still need for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: That’d be great, thanks—just let me know what we’re short on.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Will do — I’ll check what we’ve got and make a list of anything we’re missing.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive? I heard it’s coming together nicely, and folks are pitching in already. I can tell you what I know if you want the latest.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, I’d appreciate the latest. What’s still needed?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Mostly supplies and a few extra hands, I think—tools, materials, and volunteers to help sort everything. If you want, I can keep an ear out for the exact list.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I want to make sure I’ve got the details right before I say yes—what time is the repair drive, and what do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: It starts at 10 a.m. in the school lot, and if you can bring a screwdriver set and any spare zip ties, that’d be great.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it—10 a.m. at the school lot, and I’ll bring a screwdriver set plus any spare zip ties I have.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, sure — what's the repair drive about again?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: It’s for folks who need help fixing up small things at home — like leaky faucets, broken steps, that sort of thing. I heard we’re collecting tools and a little funding for it.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — that sounds useful. I can probably bring a couple tools by.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’ll spread the word about the repair drive and make sure folks know when it’s happening.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Vik — I really appreciate that. It should help a lot if people hear about it early.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll mention it around the block and tell people to keep an eye out for the date. Glad to help.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—right, the repair drive. What’s the latest on it?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I haven’t checked in yet—sorry. I’m still sorting through some things, but I’ll let you know as soon as I can.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: No worries, Uli. Just ping me when you know something.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I heard about the repair drive—what still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: A few folks still need help with leaky faucets, loose cabinet doors, and one squeaky gate. If you’ve got time, I can point you to the next house.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure, point me to the next house—I can help with whichever one needs it most.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Opal, I’ve started organizing the repair drive sign-up sheet and I’m hoping to get a few folks confirmed today. If you’re still in, I can put your name down and send you the details.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, please put me down. Send the details my way and I’ll take a look.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Wonderful, Opal — I’ve got you on the list and I’ll send the details over right away. Thank you for helping out.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m in, but I’d like to know the pickup time and where the supplies are going first. I just want to make sure the logistics are sorted.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll get the pickup time and supply drop-off details sorted and send them your way right away. Thanks for checking on the logistics!

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Quinn — once you have those details, I can plan around them.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Oh, so the repair drive is actually happening? Just want to make sure I’ve got the details right.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, it’s happening, but I want to double-check the timing and what still needs to be fixed before we say anything definite.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it — so it’s still on, but you’re confirming the timing first, right?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’d like a clear plan for the repair drive—what time are we leaving, and what do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m a bit late as usual, but let’s leave around 9:00. If you can bring the toolbox and some gloves, that’d be great.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: 9:00 works for me. I’ll bring the toolbox and gloves.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard about the repair drive from a few folks—what do they still need help with?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: We still need a few basics—batteries, duct tape, and some tools if anyone has spares. Even a little extra would help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it—I'll spread the word and see if anyone nearby has extras. Thanks for letting me know what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’m happy to help, though I may need a reminder on what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Oren — we still need a few volunteers to sort tools and help with simple fixes. If you’re free, I’d really appreciate you taking one of those spots.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure, I can take one of those spots—sorting tools sounds manageable for me. Just point me to where I should start.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around school drop-off and pickup times. What do you need from me for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: That’d be great—could you help pin down who’s available for pickups and what times work best? I’ll handle the repair list and let you know what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Absolutely—I’ll check who can do pickups and gather a few time windows that fit around school. Then I’ll send you a quick summary so you can match it to the repair list.
